_comment: Reviewer-requested critical-load priority sensitivity configuration; created 2026-11-09 before lambda sweep. Identical to ieee33_main.json except lambda_critical=10.
load_profile_source: IEEE RTS-79 winter weekday hourly load (% of daily peak), hour 0-23

bess._note: Merged R1/R2 decision 2026-11-02: 60 kW / 60 kVA per BESS (manuscript three-phase section) and all BESS grid-forming-capable when islanded. Grid-connected BESS provide Volt-VAR support from converter headroom.

forecast.persistence: current measured deviation from nominal is persisted over the horizon

optimizer._local_search_note: R1 search refinement declared 2026-11-02 before formal runs: Baran-Wu branch exchange on the GWO best (close one open switchable branch, open one switchable branch on the created loop; best-improvement per open branch; <= 3 passes). Verified on development seed 101 only.
optimizer._reserve_projection_note: R1 search refinement declared 2026-11-02 before formal runs: BESS set-points are projected so that, after each step k, stored energy >= max(E_min, E_res - (Tp-k-1)*P_rated*eta*dt); i.e. the terminal reserve stays reachable (forced charging when below). Applied in planning and in the plant. Verified on development seed 101 only.

osi.feeder_limit_rule: loadability: max total demand (forecast spatial pattern) the current topology serves within V and I limits
